From the graph, the circle has center  
\[
O=(-1,1)
\]
and radius  
\[
r=3.
\]
The point \(P\) is at  
\[
P=(0,1),
\]
so
\[
OP=\sqrt{(0-(-1))^2+(1-1)^2}=1.
\]

For chords passing through an interior point \(P\), the shortest chord is perpendicular to \(OP\). Its length is
\[
2\sqrt{r^2-OP^2}.
\]
Thus,
\[
L_{\min}=2\sqrt{3^2-1^2}
=2\sqrt{9-1}
=2\sqrt{8}
=4\sqrt{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{4\sqrt{2}\text{ units}}
\]
